# Amazon.co.jp
> Amazon Japan’s online marketplace for shopping, digital content, subscriptions, account services, and seller programs.

Amazon.co.jp serves customers in Japan with retail shopping, Prime benefits, digital media, gift cards, payment services, help resources, and marketplace tools for sellers and brands.

## Shopping
- [Amazon.co.jp Home](https://www.amazon.co.jp/): Main storefront for browsing products, recommendations, and promotions across all categories.
- [Best Sellers](https://www.amazon.co.jp/gp/bestsellers): Best-selling products ranked by category across the Amazon.co.jp marketplace.
- [New Releases](https://www.amazon.co.jp/gp/new-releases): Newly launched products gaining popularity across major shopping categories.
- [Movers & Shakers](https://www.amazon.co.jp/gp/movers-and-shakers): Products with the biggest recent sales rank gains.
- [Today's Deals](https://www.amazon.co.jp/gp/goldbox): Time-limited deals, discounts, and promotional offers across categories.
- [Customer Service](https://www.amazon.co.jp/gp/help/customer/display.html): Help hub for orders, returns, payments, devices, and account issues.

## Programs & Membership
- [Amazon Prime](https://www.amazon.co.jp/amazonprime): Prime membership benefits including shipping, video, music, and exclusive offers.
- [Prime Student](https://www.amazon.co.jp/amazonprime?primeCampaignId=studentWlpPrimeRedir): Student-focused Prime membership with discounted pricing and trial benefits.
- [Amazon Family](https://www.amazon.co.jp/family): Family-oriented offers and recurring purchase benefits for household essentials.
- [Subscribe & Save](https://www.amazon.co.jp/b?node=3338926051): Scheduled recurring deliveries with discounts on eligible everyday products.
- [Amazon Global](https://www.amazon.co.jp/b?node=3534638051): International shipping information for eligible items sold on Amazon.co.jp.

## Account & Orders
- [Your Account](https://www.amazon.co.jp/gp/css/homepage.html): Central dashboard for account settings, orders, payments, and memberships.
- [Your Orders](https://www.amazon.co.jp/gp/css/order-history): Order history, tracking, invoices, returns, and purchase details.
- [Login & Security](https://www.amazon.co.jp/ap/cnep): Manage password, passkey, two-step verification, and account security settings.
- [Customer Preferences](https://www.amazon.co.jp/customer-preferences/edit): Set language, currency, and regional shopping preferences.
- [Address Book](https://www.amazon.co.jp/a/addresses): Manage shipping addresses for checkout and gifting.
- [Payment Options](https://www.amazon.co.jp/cpe/yourpayments/wallet): Manage cards, bank accounts, and stored payment methods.

## Returns, Shipping & Help
- [Returns Center](https://www.amazon.co.jp/returns): Start and manage returns for eligible orders.
- [Track Your Package](https://www.amazon.co.jp/gp/help/customer/display.html?nodeId=GCU8BWGTQNJKQEBS): Help resource for shipment tracking and delivery status.
- [Shipping Rates & Policies](https://www.amazon.co.jp/gp/help/customer/display.html?nodeId=GKM69DUUYKQWKWX7): Shipping options, fees, delivery estimates, and policy details.
- [Exchange or Return Items](https://www.amazon.co.jp/gp/help/customer/display.html?nodeId=GKM69DUUYKQWKWX7): Overview of return eligibility, methods, and refund processing.
- [Help Home](https://www.amazon.co.jp/gp/help/customer/display.html): Browse support topics for shopping, devices, digital services, and accounts.

## Gift Cards & Payments
- [Gift Cards](https://www.amazon.co.jp/gp/browse.html?node=2229202051): Buy, redeem, and manage Amazon.co.jp gift cards and balances.
- [Reload Your Balance](https://www.amazon.co.jp/b?node=5609898051): Add funds to your Amazon gift card balance for future purchases.
- [Amazon Pay](https://pay.amazon.co.jp/): Payment service for using Amazon account credentials on external merchant sites.
- [Amazon Points](https://www.amazon.co.jp/b?node=4731377051): Information about earning and using points on eligible purchases.
- [Payment Help](https://www.amazon.co.jp/gp/help/customer/display.html?nodeId=GFBWMNXEPYVJAY9A): Support information for payment methods, billing, and transaction issues.

## Digital Content & Entertainment
- [Prime Video](https://www.amazon.co.jp/gp/video/storefront): Streaming movies, TV shows, and Amazon Originals for Japan.
- [Amazon Music](https://www.amazon.co.jp/music/unlimited): Music streaming subscriptions and catalog access on Amazon Music.
- [Kindle Store](https://www.amazon.co.jp/kindle-dbs/storefront): Ebooks, manga, and digital reading content for Kindle devices and apps.
- [Audible Japan](https://www.amazon.co.jp/hz/audible/mlp): Audiobook subscription service with spoken-word and podcast content.
- [Amazon Games App](https://www.amazon.co.jp/b?node=10436208051): Access Amazon gaming-related downloads and promotional content.
- [Appstore for Android](https://www.amazon.co.jp/mobile-apps/b?node=2478812051): Android app marketplace and app distribution through Amazon.

## Devices & Services
- [Amazon Devices](https://www.amazon.co.jp/b?node=3446864051): Hub for Echo, Fire TV, Kindle, Ring, and other Amazon devices.
- [Kindle E-readers](https://www.amazon.co.jp/kindle-e-reader/b?node=2275256051): Kindle hardware lineup for ebook reading and digital libraries.
- [Fire TV](https://www.amazon.co.jp/firetv): Streaming media devices and Fire TV product information.
- [Echo & Alexa](https://www.amazon.co.jp/echo): Smart speakers, displays, and Alexa-enabled devices.
- [Ring](https://www.amazon.co.jp/stores/Ring/page/6D7A6E9A-0B8A-4A8A-9A2D-0A8C1F0A9B8D): Smart home security devices including video doorbells and cameras.
- [Device Support](https://www.amazon.co.jp/gp/help/customer/display.html?nodeId=201829180): Support resources for setup, troubleshooting, and device account management.

## Selling on Amazon
- [Sell on Amazon](https://sell.amazon.co.jp/): Seller program overview for listing products and reaching Amazon customers in Japan.
- [Seller Central](https://sellercentral.amazon.co.jp/): Seller portal for inventory, orders, advertising, and account operations.
- [Fulfillment by Amazon](https://sell.amazon.co.jp/fulfillment-by-amazon): Logistics service for storage, packing, shipping, and customer service.
- [Amazon Advertising for Sellers](https://advertising.amazon.com/ja-jp/solutions/products/sponsored-products): Sponsored ads and retail media tools for marketplace sellers.
- [Brand Registry](https://brandservices.amazon.co.jp/): Brand protection and intellectual property tools for registered brands.
- [Seller University](https://sell.amazon.co.jp/learn): Educational resources for starting and growing an Amazon selling business.

## Business & Professional Services
- [Amazon Business](https://www.amazon.co.jp/business): Business purchasing with invoicing, approvals, and organization accounts.
- [Business Help](https://www.amazon.co.jp/gp/help/customer/display.html?nodeId=202186370): Support information for Amazon Business accounts and purchasing workflows.
- [Amazon Hub Counter](https://www.amazon.co.jp/b?node=8472604051): Pickup location service for collecting eligible orders at partner counters.
- [Amazon Pharmacy](https://www.amazon.co.jp/pharmacy): Online pharmacy and prescription-related shopping services in Japan.
- [Amazon Fresh](https://www.amazon.co.jp/alm/storefront): Grocery delivery storefront for fresh food and household essentials.

## Policies & Legal
- [Conditions of Use](https://www.amazon.co.jp/gp/help/customer/display.html?nodeId=GLSBYFE9MGKKQXXM): Terms governing use of Amazon.co.jp services and marketplace features.
- [Privacy Notice](https://www.amazon.co.jp/gp/help/customer/display.html?nodeId=468496): Privacy policy covering data collection, use, and customer rights.
- [Specified Commercial Transactions Act](https://www.amazon.co.jp/gp/help/customer/display.html?nodeId=201909000): Legal disclosures required for ecommerce transactions in Japan.
- [Consumer Contract Information](https://www.amazon.co.jp/gp/help/customer/display.html?nodeId=201910060): Additional legal and customer protection information for Amazon.co.jp services.
- [Interest-Based Ads Notice](https://www.amazon.co.jp/gp/help/customer/display.html?nodeId=201909010): Information about advertising preferences and personalized ads controls.
